requirements.title: Terms and privacy at signup
requirements.checks: Show fresh unchecked choices; access current Equals terms, independent privacy agreement, actual signup success and separately retained consent. Block each missing prerequisite. Electronic signing also needs a signed sample.

requirements.title: Provider disclosure and safeguarding
requirements.checks: Show each provider, separate Equals balance, the current approved safeguarding wording beside it, and the working Equals terms link.

requirements.title: Marketing disclosures
requirements.checks: Capture each relevant marketing page footer with its exact URL. Attach confirmation of review against the current Financial Promotions Guidance.

requirements.title: Complaints routes
requirements.checks: Show both app and marketing homepage routes, correct UK/EU Equals complaints page and which services Equals provides.

requirements.title: Fees before commitment
requirements.checks: Show fees/annex or linked fee page before signup. Corporate scope additionally needs the customer-held written schedule.

requirements.title: Fees and FX before authorization
requirements.checks: Show beneficiary amount, fee, total debit and an actual resulting staging transaction; show FX rate before authorization where offered.

requirements.title: Real-time balances
requirements.checks: Record a real Equals staging balance change and app refresh. If derived, document reconciliation frequency, tolerance, alerts and remediation.

requirements.title: MFA protected events
requirements.checks: Show the factor actually entered/completed and wrong or missing factor blocked for every protected event. Include supported changes and maker/checker creation/approval evidence.

requirements.title: MFA challenge content
requirements.checks: Cover recipient-add, new-recipient payment, one-off payment and batches where supported. Record delivered messages or approval screens, not just developer templates; show required payee/amount/fee/total/trusted-payee fields.

requirements.title: In-app approval and device enrolment
requirements.checks: Use an actually enrolled device. Show details, biometric/passcode, confirmation, rejected/expired challenge blocked, device enrolment MFA and binding to one action. Code-delivery also needs lock-screen and dismissed challenge retrieval.

requirements.title: Equals online-card 3DS
requirements.checks: Actual online Equals card challenge with merchant and amount, successful authentication and failed/abandoned decline. Equals cards currently excluded by user.

requirements.title: Equals card details reveal
requirements.checks: Show step-up or current-session SCA within five minutes; show step-up after five minutes. Use only sandbox card details. Equals cards currently excluded by user.

requirements.title: UK GBP Confirmation of Payee
requirements.checks: Show all four results; close/no-match must block until an explicit customer choice. Keep acknowledgement evidence.

requirements.title: EUR SEPA Verification of Payee
requirements.checks: Same result/acknowledgement coverage as CoP. The supplied v12 guidance defers evidence while sandbox support is unavailable; confirm current availability before a certification run.

requirements.title: EUR SEPA batch verification
requirements.checks: Show line results and mismatch review. Corporate opt-out must be explicit, recorded and reversible; consumers cannot opt out. Supplied v12 defers sandbox evidence; batch FPS needs no CoP evidence.
